tab1Desc,"Getting Started\nUpon entering a new world you will see a bag on your toolbelt.  Open it up.\nIt contains starting armor, weapons, consumables.\n            [1E27B3]JUST PUT THE DAMN BACKPACK ON ALREADY![-]\nYou have a weight system in 5th Day, if you are overweight, then your fat ass ain't moving.\nLearn By Doing\nLearn by doing has been brought back to 7D2D in 5th Day.\nWanna get stronger with clubs, use it.\nWant to be better with a bow? Kill enemies with one.\n Want to be more proficient with a gun? Shoot the damn thing.\nSame with tools, want to harvest more ore with the pickaxe. Go mining.\nSame with wrenching.\n     If you don't use your skills then you are worse than a noob. Some workbenchs require s-core wireless power. Basically have to have a battery bank or generator running within 10 blocks.* Cooking requires a propane camp stove and black propane tank. Fueled by a white propane tank (can be found in large tanks)\nJeff had this weird thought that he should take the idea from Crystal Hell mod (Thanks Shavick) and build upon the learn by doing system.
